resources.string: Titan Gamepad turns the Titan 2 Elite physical keyboard into a virtual gamepad while it is toggled on. No keys are blocked: mapped keys send their gamepad input and also pass through, unmapped keys send blank input and pass through. Controller: WASD D-pad, KLJI face, Q/E shoulders, C/N L2/R2, T/Y L3/R3, Enter Select, Space Start, M Menu. O toggles WASD between D-pad and left stick, P toggles KLJI between face buttons and right stick. Launch the Titan Gamepad icon to cycle Off, Controller, Off.
